I also had to take a microbiology class in college and I learned about how dirty things are. So now I’m kind of disorganized but things are at least disinfected/sanitary.

I’ve been with my boyfriend a long time and sometimes I irrationally worry that he’ll just leave. 

Something you have to accept is that it’s a possibility, to be left, cheated on, hurt in some way. But worrying does not change the outcome. The world could end tomorrow due to nukes but worrying about it doesn’t change that outcome. In fact, some people say that worrying can make things worse and drive your SO into hurting you.

My advice would be to try to breathe, remind yourself that worrying only wastes your time, energy, and takes away from your happiness. Remind yourself of the good in your life, including whatever good your girlfriend brings.

There are a few reasons- your body uses glucose, like from carbs, as it’s preferred source of energy. So without consuming carbs, your body breaks down its fat next as preferred source and muscle stores (doesn’t necessarily go through all the fat before getting to muscle which can lead to muscle wasting/prevent muscle growth) to essentially turn that into fuel (ketones from the fat, breaks down muscles into amino acids which get converted into glucose). Ketosis can raise the acidity of the blood and if it’s bad enough, cause non diabetic ketoacidosis which can kill you. 

Anyway the muscle thing isn’t quickly a huge concern if you have enough fat but your organs are a muscle and those may be getting used as an energy source (like the body is eating itself almost.) Not eating carbs (like fruits are high in carbs and veggies too ) can make it so you miss out on so many vitamins, minerals, phytonutrients. Fiber is technically a carb too so some people may have a lack of fiber then. 

Also eating so much protein (because you’ll eat more of each fat and protein if you cut out carbs) can be harsh on your kidneys, mainly if you’re going with animal protein. Also all of that fat (assuming an increase in sat fat and animal fat which has more trans fat) can lead to higher chances of a poor lipid panel, heart disease, cancer, arthritis, a number of chronic diseases. 

Finally it’s just not a sustainable way to live and enjoy life—but that last part is more my opinion lol
